parsed.post: Kept depth-6 on clean shards 0-9: val_bpb 1.0197 vs 1.0481. Batch 262144 + warmup 0.05 + WD 0.1 + LR 0.08 gives strong capacity gain. Next: MATRIX_LR 0.08->0.06 to test lower LR stability on depth-6. Shards remain 0-9 to avoid eval leakage.
parsed.description: Keep the clean depth-6 gain, then lower MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.06 to test whether a more conservative optimizer improves depth-6 convergence on shards 0-9.
